description: Four downstream-application compatibility requests. These are app contracts, not generated context/user-study cases.

summary.visitor_presence_detection: ChokePoint/YOLO app consumes image/video/frame inputs; semantic detections/events are rejected as preprocessing outputs.
summary.fall_detection: LE2I fall app consumes pose keypoint sequences; raw video/event labels are rejected as downstream inputs.
summary.adl_recognition: YouHome ADL app consumes AV sample/manifest with image frames and audio waveform by default; activity labels/summaries are rejected.
summary.domestic_sound_monitoring: CHiME-Home app consumes audio waveform chunks; sound labels/decibel/transcripts are rejected as preprocessing outputs.
